dataset_metadata.disclaimer: This is a SYNTHETIC/DEMO dataset created solely for testing the SIH competency intelligence platform. It does NOT represent actual live or private courses of iGOT Karmayogi or the Government of India.

courses.title: Introduction to Official Survey Design
courses.description: Learn the fundamentals of designing surveys, constructing questionnaires, and planning fieldwork for national census and statistical operations.

courses.title: Advanced Survey Design and Data Quality Control
courses.description: Deep dive into survey design methodologies, questionnaire validation, and implementing quality control frameworks.

courses.title: Sampling Techniques for Household Surveys
courses.description: Covers probability sampling, stratification, cluster sampling, and calculation of sampling weights.

courses.title: Advanced Probability Sampling Methods
courses.description: Explores complex sampling methodologies, multi-stage stratified designs, estimation theory, and variance estimation.

courses.title: Data Quality Assurance Frameworks
courses.description: A comprehensive analysis of statistical quality assurance models, identifying and correcting non-sampling errors.

courses.title: Metadata Standards, SDMX and DDI Compliance
courses.description: Learn metadata structures, designing data catalogs, and implementing international SDMX formats for statistical exchanges.

courses.title: Python for Data Analysis in Public Administration
courses.description: Practical Python programming using Pandas, NumPy, and Matplotlib to analyze public sector data.

courses.title: Database Querying with SQL
courses.description: Comprehensive course on writing SELECT statements, JOINs, aggregations, and subqueries.

courses.title: Advanced SQL and Database Optimization
courses.description: Covers performance tuning, query planning, indexing strategies, and database schema design for statisticians.

courses.title: Advanced Python: Data Pipelines and Automation
courses.description: Learn to write clean code, create automated ETL pipelines, and script data integrations.

courses.title: Geospatial Analysis and QGIS Basics
courses.description: Introduction to spatial databases, geographic coordinates systems, and building map layers in QGIS.

courses.title: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Statistics
courses.description: Understand linear regressions, clustering methods, random forests, and neural networks applied to economic forecasts.

courses.title: Understanding Data Privacy Laws in India
courses.description: Introduction to the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, consent management, and data protection rules.

courses.title: Cybersecurity Fundamentals for Civil Servants
courses.description: Overview of threats, information security frameworks, secure browser configurations, and digital public security standards.

courses.title: Effective Project Management in Government Agencies
courses.description: Learn project lifecycle planning, resource allocation, and reporting for government schemes.

courses.title: Executive Leadership and Strategic Vision
courses.description: Covers high-level decision making, organizational alignment, conflict resolution, and motivational leadership.
